head.text: Interrupt controller register write - DEVMAP shortens nINTCTRL_CS on writes

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S0 S1 S2 S3

foot.text: The INTCTRL registers are clocked by the rising edge of (nINTCTRL_CS OR R/W OR address). DEVMAP's nINTCTRL_CS_delay flop ends the chip select at the first falling clock edge of a write, so the edge lands mid-cycle while the CPU is still driving the data. The same pattern would help the PTC and the 7-segment latches, which are clocked at the end of the cycle.
